title: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) saw a man praying alone behind the row, so he commanded him to repeat his prayer
hadeeth: Wābisah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) saw a man praying alone behind the row, so he commanded him to repeat his prayer.
attribution: Narrated by Abu Dāwūd, At-Tirmidhi, Ibn Mājah, and Ahmad
explanation: The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) saw a man praying alone behind the row, so he commanded him to repeat his prayer because his prayer was invalid in that state.
hints: Encouraging the act of going to the congregational prayer early and seeking to find a place in the first rows and not to pray alone behind the row so as not to invalidate one's prayer.

Ibn Hajar said: Whoever starts the prayer alone behind the row then joins the row before rising from Rukū‘ (bowing) is not required to repeat the prayer as indicated by the Hadīth of Abu Bakrah; otherwise, he is required to repeat it according to the general indication of the Hadīth of Wābisah.
hadeeth_intro: Wābisah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadeeth_ar: عَنْ وَابِصَةَ رضي الله عنه: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَأَى رَجُلًا صَلَّى وَحْدَهُ خَلْفَ الصَّفِّ، فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُعِيدَ صَلَاتَهُ.
explanation_ar: رَأى النبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رجلًا صلَّى وحده خَلْفَ الصف، فأمرَه أن يعيد صلاته؛ لأن صلاته لم تصح على هذه الحالة.
hints_ar: الحث على التبكير لصلاة الجماعة والتقدُّم لها، وأنْ لا يصليَ خلف الصف مُنْفَرِدًا حتى لا يعرض صلاته للبطلان.
قال ابن حجر: من ابتدأ الصلاة منفردًا خلف الصف ثم دخل في الصف قبل القيام من الركوع لم تجب عليه الإعادة، كما في حديث أبي بكرة، وإلا فيجب على عموم حديث وابصة.
attribution_ar: رواه أبو داود والترمذي وابن ماجه وأحمد
